subject: Medford Public Schools Strategic Plan Approval
overview: The Medford School Committee approved a new multi-year strategic plan for the district and authorized the creation of a federally funded 'Engagement Hub' to support student re-enrollment. The committee also finalized the fiscal year 2022 budget and reviewed an operational audit of the business office that highlighted the need for integrated financial software.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: Approved entering executive session to discuss pending litigation before the Massachusetts Commission Against Discrimination (MCAD).

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the May 24 meeting, bills, and payroll, while tabling the minutes from May 10.

items.title: Subcommittee Report: Communications, Strategic Planning, and Stakeholder Engagement
items.summary: Approved the subcommittee minutes following a discussion on the development of the district strategic plan and the goal of authentic family engagement.

items.title: Subcommittee Report: Buildings and Grounds
items.summary: Approved several facilities requests including a student poll for high school signage, the replacement of the high school hot water and generator systems, and repairs to the high school transformer and the Curtis Tufts boiler.

items.title: FY 2022 Budget Approval
items.summary: Approved the fiscal year 2022 school department budget following a report from the Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Received emails from three citizens requesting that the committee return to its original 7:00 p.m. meeting start time to facilitate better public attendance.

items.title: Superintendent’s Updates
items.summary: Received updates regarding recent graduation and prom activities, a visit from the state Commissioner of Education, and upcoming middle school open houses.

items.title: COVID-19 Health Update
items.summary: Received a summary of district COVID-19 testing results showing zero positive cases last week and an update on upcoming vaccination clinics.

items.title: Donations and Grants
items.summary: Approved a $2,500 donation from the Leonard and Lois Green Foundation for Haitian Flag Day and accepted a $350,000 Cummings Foundation grant for the Center for Citizenship and Social Responsibility.

items.title: Special Education and Safety Reports
items.summary: Received reports from the Universal Safety Committee on emergency preparedness and from SEPAC regarding annual highlights and staff awards.

items.title: Strategic Plan Approval
items.summary: Approved the updated Medford Public Schools Strategic Plan focusing on Achievement, Collaboration, Equity, and Support (ACES). The committee also voted to establish the plan as an annual presentation requirement.

items.title: Business Services Operational Review
items.summary: Received and placed on file a consultant's report recommending the district implement integrated financial software to replace current manual payroll and budget tracking systems.

items.title: Engagement Hub Initiative
items.summary: Approved a proposal to use federal ESSER funds to establish an 'Engagement Hub' and hire three to five re-engagement specialists to support student retention and family outreach.

items.title: Meeting Dates and Renaming Committee
items.summary: Approved the 2021-2022 meeting schedule as amended and granted a one-week extension to the Columbus Elementary School renaming committee, with instructions for a final vote on June 14.

items.title: New Business and Policies
items.summary: Referred a policy on public participation in minutes to subcommittee, approved a new recyclable materials policy, and authorized administration to develop a proposal for a high school vision committee.
